description: This Java class, FixedDepositWorkbookPopulator, is part of a bulk import infrastructure for fixed deposit products in the Fineract system. It handles creating and populating an Excel workbook for fixed deposits, including setting data validation rules, default values, and layout for the import process.

classes.name: FixedDepositWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating an Excel workbook with fixed deposit data, applying validation rules, setting defaults, and defining layout for bulk import.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Generates the fixed deposit sheet and invokes populators for related sheets, then sets rules, defaults, lookup tables, and layout.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for various columns in the fixed deposit sheet, such as dropdown lists and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges for reference data like offices, clients, and products, used in data validation formulas.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Populates default formulas and values into the sheet, initializing dropdowns and calculated fields.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths, providing the sheet layout and column labels.
